mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 7.0% for three consecutive months, it signals labor market weakness that triggers defensive equity rotation, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 7.0% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint rise of real GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) above their 12-month moving averages signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST exceed 12mo MA, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high industrial production growth (INDPRO > 1.5% qoq), manufacturing expansion signals elevated corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 1.5% qoq, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 100,000 monthly additions signals labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 100,000, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 850,000 units, it indicates housing sector contraction that reduces consumer wealth and confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 850.0, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) and high core inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) signals persistent inflation amid accommodative policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: low interest rate, high inflation regime
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.0% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low interest rate environment (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased risk appetite and lower corporate financing costs.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
